_comment: Trapline gang definitions. Edited here, reloaded on script start (Insert reloads SHVDN).
id                 stable key used in save files; never change it once you have a save
tag                4-character label drawn on the wheel
relationshipGroup  vanilla ped relationship group. Membership is detected by THIS, not by
ped model, so every gang ped the game spawns is recognised. If the group
does not exist, Trapline creates it (and then nothing will match it).
colour             [r,g,b] used for the wheel tint and the gang panel
rivals             gang ids this gang is at war with. Dealing on a rival's turf gets you jumped.
turf               GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes this gang claims
joinRespect        respect needed before they will take you on
IMPORTANT -- the turf zone codes below are a best-effort starting map. An unrecognised
code simply never matches, which quietly costs that gang some territory. To build an
accurate map, stand somewhere in game, open the wheel, and pick Turf > Log zone. The exact
code is written to scripts\Trapline.log and shown on screen. Paste it into the right list.

gangs.name: Ballas
gangs.turfHint: Grove Street, Forum Drive, South Rancho

gangs.name: Los Santos Vagos
gangs.turfHint: El Burro Heights, Rancho, La Mesa
